Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4649955. Filter for rows where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is '='. Join activities to assays on assay_id, join activities to compound_records on record_id, join compound_records to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Sort by chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
